Update V2.2

21 New emote!! NEW

  • Halloween: Casper walk, Spider walk, Headless 2, Head dribble, Zombie pose 3 (5 Halloween)
  • Pose: Pose 45 to 52, Leaning pose 11 (9 poses)
  • Sit: Sit 17 to 21 (5 sit)
  • Dance: Shigure, Lucky bon

New feature!! NEW

  • Stop emote by crouching. If a player crouches and then clicks a rieemote item, the emote stops. The effect is the same as the "Clear Emote" button, and there's a random.orb sound.

Bug remake

  • 6 animations: brazildance2, fightpose, flyingpose, pose19, scuba, and sit16

Tutorial

  • Install the add-on as usual.
  • Find rieemote and rieecam for use.

How to emote

  • Hold rieemote + right click

How to stop emote

  • Hold rieemote + sneak + right click
  • Hold rieemote + right click + click Clear Emote

How to freecam

  • Hold rieecam + right click

How to stop freecam

  • Hold rieecam + right click

How to cam

  • Hold rieecam + sneak + right click

How to stop cam

  • Hold rieecam + sneak + right click
